text: Ititu is concentrated by repeated topping up and draining, so it ends as a sour curd, not a drink.

steps.note: Every 3–4 days whey is drained off and fresh milk added until the curd is thick.

processing.text: No starter; natural fermentation. Every 3-4 days whey is drained off and fresh milk added until the curd is thick; the Borana study gives 1 week to 3 months.
